description: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. is a global, independent chemical company, incorporated as a Naamloze Vennootschap under Dutch law on October 15, 2009, that participates globally across the petrochemical value chain and is an industry leader in many of its product lines. Its chemicals businesses consist primarily of large processing plants that convert large volumes of liquid and gaseous hydrocarbon feedstocks into plastic resins and other chemicals, and its chemical products tend to be basic building blocks for other chemicals and plastics, while its plastic products are used in large volumes as well as smaller specialty applications, with customers using its plastics and chemicals to manufacture a wide range of products people use in their everyday lives, including food packaging, home furnishings, automotive components, paints and coatings. It reports segments including Olefins and Polyolefins, Intermediates and Derivatives, Advanced Polymer Solutions and Technology.
